title: Police Step in When Creep Rapes Woman
description:
On September 15th, 2022, dispatch received a 911 emergency call regarding an ongoing domestic battery. Here is what the caller told dispatch. Suspecting a possible attempted murder, officers were immediately dispatched to the location. The woman was shaking and completely traumatised. She explained how her ex-boyfriend had tried to hurt her, prompting the officers to call for an ambulance.She narrated the entire incident to the officer, providing them with more clues about the suspect. The woman explained that the man had intentions to end her life and was continuously trying to choke her with a charging cable. Shortly after, medics arrived to check on the woman. The next day, officers were informed that the man kept calling the woman. She believed that he must have returned to his motel room. Shortly after, the woman received another call from her ex-boyfriend. While interviewing the victim, one of the detectives talked to the suspect over the phone. The officers were able to locate the suspect based on the calls and the description provided by the woman. The man was soon taken to the hospital for a checkup. He was transported to jail after the check-up. Later, the victim called for a counsellor because she was feeling upset. She explained to the officer that she did not want the details of the case to be circulated in the newspaper and on social media. The male was charged with domestic battery, resisting arrest, aggravated battery on a household member, attempt to murder, false imprisonment and interference.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
